title: Composed supervisory control: Good/reject batch statistics with reject lockout -> Two-out-of-three sensor voter

inputs.name: A_BatchTarget
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Total parts in a batch

outputs.name: A_QualityFault
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Reject count exceeded limit

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: A_BatchTarget and A_RejectLimit remain positive and constant during a test.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A good-part rising edge increments only A_GoodCount; a reject-part rising edge increments only A_RejectCount.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Simultaneous good and reject edges shall count one reject and no good part.
requirements.property: G((rose(A_GoodPart) AND rose(A_RejectPart) AND !A_Reset) -> (A_RejectCount=prev(A_RejectCount)+1 AND A_GoodCount=prev(A_GoodCount)))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_BatchDone shall be TRUE when A_GoodCount plus A_RejectCount reaches A_BatchTarget.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_QualityFault shall latch when A_RejectCount reaches A_RejectLimit and remain set until A_Reset.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall clear both counts, A_BatchDone, and A_QualityFault.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Vote shall be TRUE when at least two of B_S1, B_S2, and B_S3 are TRUE.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Vote = ((B_S1 AND B_S2) OR (B_S1 AND B_S3) OR (B_S2 AND B_S3))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Unanimous shall be TRUE only when all three channels have the same value.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> (B_Unanimous = ((B_S1 AND B_S2 AND B_S3) OR ((!B_S1) AND (!B_S2) AND (!B_S3)))))

requirements.text: A TRUE A_BatchDone shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND NOT B_Vote AND NOT B_Unanimous)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (NOT B_Vote AND NOT B_Unanimous))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

composition.runtime_design: one stateful primary subsystem plus one stateless Boolean subsystem

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
